_contract: Frozen in the Phase 0 commit, before any ACG resolver existed. Do not edit to make an implementation pass. 'partition' lists every executed action with a capability; actions in 'no_effect_actions' must not belong to any capability. 'classes' maps action ids to the expected behavioral class of their capability; no T1 log contains reproduction or oracle evidence, so no class may be asserted.

t1_1_dispatch.why: Same endpoint and parameter names; the 'controller' value is constant per affordance and differs across affordances, so it dispatches.

t1_2_labels.why: Identical request and effect signatures behind 'Save' and '保存' are one capability with two bindings; 'Export' was never executed.

t1_3_client.why: No requests; different component regions change. a3 changes nothing observable and is not a capability.

t1_4_websocket.why: Sent WebSocket message classes are operations; two distinct discriminators, one shared by two affordances.

t1_5_canvas.why: Two different gestures with only a canvas-region digest change: one unidentified operation family (documented limit).

t1_6_revision.why: Same visible affordance, different operation after a handler revision; the split is explained by a learned context predicate.

t1_7_entry_points.why: Form and empty-state button share one signature (two entry points). Three canvases are three instances of one template.

t1_8_indistinguishable.why: Two different settings through one endpoint with identical parameters and no dispatch value: indistinguishable from this evidence.
